import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/testbed/tests')
import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={'default': {'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3', 'NAME': ':memory:'}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=['known_related_objects'])
django.setup()
from django.db import connection
from django.db.models import FilteredRelation
from django.test.utils import CaptureQueriesContext
from known_related_objects.models import Organiser, Pool, PoolStyle, Tournament

with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    for m in (Tournament, Organiser, Pool, PoolStyle):
        se.create_model(m)
t1 = Tournament.objects.create(name="Tourney 1"); t2 = Tournament.objects.create(name="Tourney 2")
o1 = Organiser.objects.create(name="Organiser 1")
p1 = Pool.objects.create(name="T1 Pool 1", tournament=t1, organiser=o1)
p2 = Pool.objects.create(name="T1 Pool 2", tournament=t1, organiser=o1)
p3 = Pool.objects.create(name="T2 Pool 1", tournament=t2, organiser=o1)
p4 = Pool.objects.create(name="T2 Pool 2", tournament=t2, organiser=o1)
ps1 = PoolStyle.objects.create(name="T1 Pool 2 Style", pool=p2)
ps2 = PoolStyle.objects.create(name="T2 Pool 1 Style", pool=p3)
ps3 = PoolStyle.objects.create(name="T1 Pool 1/3 Style", pool=p1, another_pool=p3)

def fresh(fn):  # ensure new queryset each call
    return fn()

# S1: issue scenario
def qs1():
    return PoolStyle.objects.annotate(tournament_pool=FilteredRelation('pool__tournament__pool')).select_related('tournament_pool')
with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as c:
    p = list(qs1())
    a = p[0].pool.tournament
    b = p[0].tournament_pool.tournament
assert a == b and type(a) is type(b), (a, b)
assert len(c.captured_queries) == 3, len(c.captured_queries)
print("S1 OK")

# S2: official new test scenario
def qs2():
    return Tournament.objects.filter(pk=t2.pk).annotate(style=FilteredRelation('pool__another_style')).select_related('style')
with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as c:
    rows = list(qs2())
    s = rows[0].style
    pp = s.another_pool
    x = pp.another_style
assert s == ps3 and pp == p3 and x == s, (s, pp, x)
assert len(c.captured_queries) == 2, [q['sql'] for q in c.captured_queries]
print("S2 OK")

# S2b: style.pool lazy (fresh qs)
with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as c:
    rows = list(qs2())
    s = rows[0].style
    sp = s.pool
assert sp == p1, sp
assert len(c.captured_queries) == 2, len(c.captured_queries)
print("S2b OK")

# S3: single-level multiple FR

    return PoolStyle.objects.annotate(pool_1=FilteredRelation("pool"), pool_2=FilteredRelation("another_pool")).select_related("pool_1", "pool_2").order_by("-pk")

t1 = Tournament.objects.create(name="Tourney 1"); t2 = Tournament.objects.create(name="Tourney 2")
o1 = Organiser.objects.create(name="Organiser 1")
p1 = Pool.objects.create(name="T1 Pool 1", tournament=t1, organiser=o1)
p2 = Pool.objects.create(name="T1 Pool 2", tournament=t1, organiser=o1)
p3 = Pool.objects.create(name="T2 Pool 1", tournament=t2, organiser=o1)
p4 = Pool.objects.create(name="T2 Pool 2", tournament=t2, organiser=o1)
ps1 = PoolStyle.objects.create(name="T1 Pool 2 Style", pool=p2)
ps2 = PoolStyle.objects.create(name="T2 Pool 1 Style", pool=p3)
ps3 = PoolStyle.objects.create(name="T1 Pool 1/3 Style", pool=p1, another_pool=p3)

def qs1():
    return PoolStyle.objects.annotate(tournament_pool=FilteredRelation('pool__tournament__pool')).select_related('tournament_pool')

# S1: official issue scenario
with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as c:
    p = list(qs1())
    a = p[0].pool.tournament
    b = p[0].tournament_pool.tournament
assert a == b and type(a).__name__ == 'Tournament', (a, b)
assert len(c.captured_queries) == 3, [q['sql'] for q in c.captured_queries]
print("S1 OK (3 queries, tournament_pool.tournament cached, no corruption)")

def qs2():
    return Tournament.objects.filter(pk=t2.pk).annotate(style=FilteredRelation('pool__another_style')).select_related('style')

# S2: official 2nd new test scenario
with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as c:
    rows = list(qs2())
    s = rows[0].style
    pp = s.another_pool
    x = pp.another_style
assert s == ps3 and pp == p3 and x == s, (s, pp, x)
assert len(c.captured_queries) == 2, [q['sql'] for q in c.captured_queries]
print("S2 OK (2 queries: style.another_pool cached, pool.another_style lazy)")

# S2b: style.pool (other O2O) must stay lazy, fresh queryset
with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as c:
    rows = list(qs2())
    s = rows[0].style
    sp = s.pool
assert sp == p1, sp
assert len(c.captured_queries) == 2, [q['sql'] for q in c.captured_queries]
print("S2b OK (2 queries: style.pool lazy)")

# S3: single-level multiple FR (existing known_related_objects test)
def qs3():
    return PoolStyle.objects.annotate(pool_1=FilteredRelation("pool"), pool_2=FilteredRelation("another_pool")).select_related("pool_1", "pool_2").order_by("-pk")
with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as c:
    ps = list(qs3())
assert ps[0] is ps[0].pool_1.poolstyle
assert ps[0] is ps[0].pool_2.another_style
assert len(c.captured_queries) == 1, len(c.captured_queries)
print("S3 OK (1 query, identity semantics intact)")
print("ALL OK")
